How the places compare — Census ACS

ⓘ About the Census demographics below

Income, age, renter share, and race/ethnicity are 2019–2023 ACS 5-year tract estimates (the Census Bureau's own margin of error applies, especially for smaller tracts). They describe the origin and destination tracts that arrivals/leavers touched — not the individual households, which the Census doesn't link to specific movers. A tract with more traced moves counts more heavily in the average. Age-bracket and modeled home value further down still come from Data Axle mover records only.

18,027 of 19,815 traced moves (91%) geocoded on both ends via the Census Bureau's free batch address geocoder (94.7% address match rate). Tract boundaries: Census TIGER/Line, El Paso County. Sources: Data Axle mover records; El Paso Water move-in/move-out records, matched to MLS sales and rental listings by address.
